meta.description: Machine-readable public API reference for the final (deprecated) EmptySock engine: bitECS-backed entity/component core plus the systems listed here. Load at agent task start for full typed context. No internal implementation details.
meta.status: deprecated: development has stopped; this documents the final state of the engine
meta.note_exports: InputSystem, PointerSystem, GamepadSystem, AudioSystem, PostProcessSystem, ParticleSystem, CoroutineSystem, RenderSystem and the accessibilitySettings singleton are all exported from the package index. Game code normally uses the instances the game owns (game.input, ctx.audio) rather than constructing these classes.

stack.language: TypeScript strict mode recommended; plain JavaScript is fully first-class

banned_patterns: async onUpdate() — type error in TS, runtime warning in JS
JSON.parse(x) as T — always use Zod or a real guard
mutating a networked component field in place (breaks NetworkSystem's dirty-check — reassign instead)
required_patterns: explicit return types on all functions
Zod schema (or equivalent guard) for all external/save data
scene.destroy(entity) when an entity is done — same call whether pooled or not

components.description: Built-in components. Add with entity.add(Component, overrides?). All fields are Serializable.
components.Sprite: { texturePath: '', tint: 0xffffff, alpha: 1, anchorX: 0.5, anchorY: 0.5, layer: 'default', depth: 0, visible: true, frameCount: 1, currentFrame: 0, frameSpeed: 1, loop: true, width: 0, height: 0, sliceMode: 0, sliceLeft/Right/Top/Bottom: 0, shader: '', bboxLeft/Top/Right/Bottom: 0 } — with frameCount > 1, texturePath is a template containing '{n}'
components.PhysicsBody: { type: 'dynamic'|'static'|'kinematic', shape: 'box'|'circle'|'capsule', width: 32, height: 32, radius: 16, density: 1, friction: 0.5, restitution: 0.2, isSensor: false, position: {x,y}, rotation: 0, velocity: {x,y}, bodyHandle, colliderHandle } — callbacks (onCollisionEnter/Exit, onSensorEnter/Exit/Stay) are assigned through getPhysicsBody(entity)
components.getPhysicsBody: getPhysicsBody(entity: Entity): PhysicsBodyHandle | undefined — the body data plus assignable callback properties
components.Meta: { name: '', tags: string[], active: true, persistent: false, solid: false }
components.Layout: { x, y, width, height } — computed widget box written by WidgetTree.layout()
components.LayoutStyle: { flexDirection: 0|1, width: -1, height: -1, flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 1, padding: 0, gap: 0, positionType: 0|1, left, top, overflow: 0|1|2, scrollX, scrollY }
components.Label: { text, color, fontSize, font, fontId, align: 0|1|2 }
components.ButtonState: { label, color, background, hoverBackground, pressedBackground, borderRadius, fontSize, font, fontId, disabled, state: 0|1|2 }
components.Checkbox: { checked, label, color, background, borderColor, fontSize, font, fontId }
components.Slider: { value, min, max, step, trackColor, thumbColor }
components.LightSource: { radius: 200, colour: 0xffffff, intensity: 1, falloff: 1, offsetX, offsetY, enabled: true, coneAngle: 360, coneDirection: 0 } (degrees)
components.LightOccluder: { width: 32, height: 32, offsetX, offsetY, enabled: true }
components.Projection3D: { active: false, x0..y3 } — four-corner quad projection
components.SpriteFlash: { color, amount, peak, duration, elapsed, easing, active } — use startSpriteFlash(entity, options)

CameraSystem.import: import { CameraSystem, type CameraState, type CameraBounds } from '@emptysock/engine'

methods.moveTo: moveTo(x: number, y: number): void — smooth
methods.setFollow: setFollow(fn: (() => { x: number; y: number }) | null): void
methods.worldToScreen: worldToScreen(wx: number, wy: number): { x: number; y: number }
methods.screenToWorld: screenToWorld(sx: number, sy: number): { x: number; y: number }

coroutines.import: import { startCoroutine, stopCoroutine, waitFrames, waitSeconds, waitUntil, type CoroutineHandle, type CoroutineFactory, type CoroutineGen } from '@emptysock/engine'
coroutines.description: Generator-based coroutines tied to an entity's life; they stop automatically when the entity is destroyed. Game.update() advances them.
coroutines.usage: entity.startCoroutine(function* () { yield waitSeconds(1); doSomething() }) returns a CoroutineHandle with cancel(); entity.stopCoroutine(id) stops by id

LocalisationSystem.description: Instanced translation lookup. Each scene context provides one as ctx.localisation.

methods.setLocale: setLocale(locale: string): void — fires onLocaleChange handlers
methods.addTranslations: addTranslations(locale: string, map: Record<string, string>): void — merges
methods.t: t(key: string, vars?: Record<string, string | number>): string — {{name}} substitution; returns the key when missing

PhysicsSystem.description: 2D Rapier world. Game creates and steps one per scene as ctx.physics.

methods.init: init(options?: { gravity?: {x,y}; fixedTimestep?: number; deterministic?: boolean }): Promise<void>
methods.raycast: raycast(origin: Vec2, direction: Vec2, maxToi = 1000, solid = true): RaycastHit2D | null

ParticleEmitter.import: import { ParticleEmitter, rainParticlePreset, type ParticleEmitterOptions, type EmitterShape } from '@emptysock/engine'
ParticleEmitter.description: Plain simulation class (not an ECS component). Mount on a layer with RenderPipeline.mountParticles(emitter, layerName).

methods.update: update(deltaTime: number): void — call every frame; emits continuously while active

ParticleEmitter.rainParticlePreset: rainParticlePreset(opts?: { width?: number; density?: number; wind?: number; texture?: string }): ParticleEmitterOptions

WindowSystem.import: import { WindowSystem, type WindowMode, type WindowConfig } from '@emptysock/engine'
WindowSystem.description: Window control with a Tauri desktop path and a browser fallback. Each scene context provides one as ctx.window; there is no module singleton.
WindowSystem.WindowConfig: { mode: 'windowed'|'fullscreen'|'borderless', width, height, title, resizable, minWidth, minHeight }

UISystem.import: import { UISystem, WidgetTree, LayoutStyle, Layout, WidgetAppearance, Label, PanelStyle, ButtonState, Checkbox, Slider, Progress, ImageWidget, resolveAnchoredPosition, type WidgetAnchor } from '@emptysock/engine'
UISystem.description: Entity-based screen-space UI. A widget is an entity with LayoutStyle + Layout (created by WidgetTree.createWidget) plus widget-kind components. WidgetTree lays them out with Yoga; UISystem hit-tests, dispatches pointer input and draws to an IUIRenderer (a CanvasRenderingContext2D satisfies it). There are no widget classes and no event emitters: read component state.
UISystem.constructor: new WidgetTree(); new UISystem(tree: WidgetTree, options?: { imageLoader?, fonts?: FontRegistry })

WidgetTree.init: await tree.init(): Promise<void> — loads Yoga WASM; required before layout()
WidgetTree.destroyWidget: destroyWidget(scene: Scene, entity: Entity): void — does not cascade to children
WidgetTree.parentOf: parentOf(scene: Scene, entity: Entity): Entity | undefined
WidgetTree.orderedWidgets: orderedWidgets(scene: Scene): Entity[] — root-first draw order
WidgetTree.layout: layout(scene: Scene, rootWidth: number, rootHeight: number): void

UISystem.dispatchPointerDown: dispatchPointerDown(scene, x, y, pointerId = 0): Entity | undefined
UISystem.dispatchPointerUp: dispatchPointerUp(scene, x, y, pointerId = 0): boolean — true if a click fired (toggles Checkbox)
UISystem.updateHover: updateHover(scene, x, y): void — sets ButtonState.state

UISystem.resolveAnchoredPosition: resolveAnchoredPosition(anchor, x, y, width, height, containerWidth, containerHeight): { left: number; top: number }

RenderPipeline.import: import { RenderPipeline, type RenderPipelineOptions, type TextureLoader, type TileLayerSource, type AutoTileResolver } from '@emptysock/engine'
RenderPipeline.description: The batteries-included renderer. Satisfies SceneRenderer, so game.attachRenderer(pipeline) makes Game.update() call renderFrame(main, overlays). Transform + Sprite is the entire contract for 'this shows up on screen'.

methods.renderFrame: renderFrame(main: Scene, overlays?: readonly Scene[]): void — syncs entities, particles, layer filters and the transition overlay (when a post-process sink is attached), then renders
methods.syncEntities: syncEntities(scene: Scene): void — sync without rendering
methods.renderTransitionOverlay: renderTransitionOverlay(postProcess): void — paints the active scene-transition overlay
methods.mountTilemap: mountTilemap(tilemap: TileLayerSource, renderLayer = 'default', autoTile?: AutoTileResolver): void
methods.attachLighting: attachLighting(lighting: LightingSystem | null, layerId = 'default'): void — syncs the lightmap over the camera's visible rect every renderFrame(); null detaches and frees it

SceneTransitionManager.description: Times a scene transition and calls your load callback; it never touches pixi. Not a singleton.

methods.transition: transition(load: () => void | Promise<void>, options?: { duration?: number (default 0.3); colour?: number; effect?: 'none'|'fade'|'wipe'|'slide' (default 'none') }): void — last call wins

AStarSearch.import: import { AStarSearch, type AStarSearchOptions, type AStarSearchResult } from '@emptysock/engine'
AStarSearch.description: Generic synchronous A*. Supply the graph.
AStarSearch.signature: AStarSearch<TNode>(options: { start: TNode; isGoal(node): boolean; neighbours(node): ReadonlyArray<{ node: TNode; cost: number }>; heuristic(node): number; key(node): string | number }): { path: ReadonlyArray<TNode>; found: boolean }

ShaderRegistry.import: import { registerShader, unregisterShader, hasShader, getShader, shaderIds, clearShaders, setShaderUniform, getShaderUniforms, parseShaderUniforms, type ShaderSource } from '@emptysock/engine'
ShaderRegistry.description: Module-level registry of named GLSL shaders. Point Sprite.shader at a registered id; RenderPipeline builds one shared filter per id.

signatures.registerShader: registerShader(id: string, source: { vertexSrc: string; fragmentSrc: string; wgslFragmentSrc?: string }): void
signatures.setShaderUniform: setShaderUniform(id: string, name: string, kind: 'f' | 'i', values: number[]): boolean

SpriteAnimationSystem.description: Advances Sprite.currentFrame by frameSpeed for every Sprite with frameCount > 1; loops or clamps per Sprite.loop.

systems.alsoExported: Raw system classes also exported from the package index: InputSystem, PointerSystem, GamepadSystem, AudioSystem, PostProcessSystem, ParticleSystem, CoroutineSystem, RenderSystem, AccessibilitySettings (class) and accessibilitySettings (singleton). Prefer game.input / ctx.audio instances; construct the rest only when you need them. Summaries below.

InputSystem.description: Keyboard-only layer InputManager wraps. attach(target?), detach(), flush() (call once per frame after reading), isKeyDown(code), isKeyPressed(code), isKeyReleased(code), snapshotKeys(), destroy(). Keys are KeyboardEvent.code values. Prefer InputManager actions.

GamepadSystem.import: import { GamepadSystem, type GamepadState, type DualRumbleOptions } from '@emptysock/engine'
GamepadSystem.description: Raw gamepad polling. update() each frame, getState(index): GamepadState | null, rumble(index, intensity, duration), rumbleDual(index, { weakMagnitude, strongMagnitude, duration }). Prefer input.gamepad(i) and bindings.

types.GamepadState: { connected: boolean, buttons: boolean[], axes: number[] }

PointerSystem.description: Unified mouse/touch/pen pointers, gestures and wheel. attach(target?), detach(), destroy(), update(), onPointerDown/onPointerMove/onPointerUp/onGesture/onWheel(handler) each returning an unsubscribe function, pointerCount, pointers, getPointer(id), primaryPointer. MIN_TOUCH_TARGET_SIZE is 44. Prefer input.pointers / input.gestures.

AudioSystem.description: Howler-backed audio, one per Game as ctx.audio / game.audio. masterVolume, setGroupVolume/getGroupVolume, setBusVolume/getBusVolume, load(id, src, options?), play(id), stop(id), pause(id), setPitch(id, rate), unload(id), unloadAll(), duck(bus, amount, fadeTime?), endDuck(bus, fadeTime?), isDucked(bus), defineSnapshot(name, busVolumes), transitionToSnapshot(name, duration?), update(dt), destroy().

CoroutineSystem.import: import { CoroutineSystem, waitFrames, waitSeconds, waitUntil, type CoroutineGen, type CoroutineYield } from '@emptysock/engine'
CoroutineSystem.description: Standalone name-keyed generator runner (entity coroutines via entity.startCoroutine are the normal route). start(id, gen), stop(id), stopAll(), update(dt) (call each frame), destroy().

ParticleSystem.import: import { ParticleSystem, ParticleEmitter, type ParticleBlendMode } from '@emptysock/engine'
ParticleSystem.description: Owns several ParticleEmitters. create(options?): ParticleEmitter, remove(emitter), update(dt), clear(), destroy(), emitters (ReadonlySet).

RenderSystem.import: import { RenderSystem, type RenderSystemOptions, type CameraViewport } from '@emptysock/engine'
RenderSystem.description: Low-level pixi renderer wrapper that RenderPipeline owns internally (async init(options), stage, canvas, guiStage, render(), resize(w, h), syncLighting(...), clearLighting(), renderMultiCamera(viewports)). Use RenderPipeline in game code.

accessibilitySettings.description: Global text-scale holder. accessibilitySettings.textScale (clamped to [0.5, 3]) and reset(). UISystem does not read it; apply it yourself when sizing text.

gpuTiers._note: Advisory budgets for choosing effect quality. The engine does not enforce them; the only engine behaviour keyed by tier is gpuTierRenderDefaults() (antialias and resolution).

examples: fix(physics): character clips through thin floor at high speed
perf(particles): cap emitter on low GPU tier
chore(assets): compress atlas for Pi export

builtins.description: Compile-time constants injected by the EmptySock build pipeline. Replace with literal values at build time — no runtime lookup. Available in all game files without import.

DEBUG.source: true in debug build, false in release

AutoTileSystem.import: import { AutoTileSystem, type AutoTileRule, type AutoTileRuleSet } from '@emptysock/tilemap'
AutoTileSystem.description: Selects tile variants based on an 8-neighbour bitmask (bits: 0 NW, 1 N, 2 NE, 3 W, 4 E, 5 SW, 6 S, 7 SE). Normal class (new AutoTileSystem()); lives in @emptysock/tilemap. A rule matches when (neighbourMask & rule.mask) === rule.mask; first match wins.

resolve.signature: (col: number, row: number, baseTileIndex: number, tileAt: (col: number, row: number) => number): number
resolve.description: Returns the tile index to paint at (col, row); tileAt returns the tile index at a cell (use -1 for empty). Returns baseTileIndex when no rule set is registered.

applyToLayer.description: Re-resolve every cell (keyed 'col,row') holding the base tile or one of its rule tiles, in place.

AutoTileSystem.AutoTileRuleSet: { id: string; baseTileIndex: number; rules: { mask: number; tileIndex: number }[]; defaultTileIndex: number }

VariableStore.import: import { VariableStore, evaluateCondition, type VariableCondition } from '@emptysock/engine'
VariableStore.description: Indexed integer variables (1-1000) and boolean switches (1-1000), clamped to range; setVar truncates to an integer. The game owns one (ctx.variables). Also the home of the VariableCondition seam used by VNSystem's condition nodes and choice `when`.

save.description: Write the snapshot to storage (localStorage when available).

load.description: Read it back; silently ignores missing or corrupt data.

reset.description: Clear all variables, switches and names in memory. Does not persist; call save() afterwards if needed.

VariableStore.VariableCondition: type VariableCondition = { kind: 'switch', index: number, equals: boolean } | { kind: 'variable', index: number, op: 'eq' | 'neq' | 'gt' | 'gte' | 'lt' | 'lte', value: number }
VariableStore.evaluateCondition: evaluateCondition(store: VariableStore, condition: VariableCondition): boolean — evaluates a VariableCondition against a store's current values.
VariableStore.ownership: Game-owned instance: ctx.variables inside a scene. There is no module-level variableStore singleton; construct your own for isolated state.

VNBackgroundLayer.description: Manages a background image and full-screen CG overlay with cross-fade transitions.
VNBackgroundLayer.fit: fit: 'cover' | 'contain' | 'stretch'; background defaults to 'cover', CG to 'contain'

VNSystem.import: import { VNSystem, type IVNListener, type DialogueNode, type DialogueTree } from '@emptysock/vn'
VNSystem.description: Standalone visual novel runtime. Loads a DialogueTree (converted from Story Graph JSON via storyGraphToDialogueTree). Used by VNTextbox as its data source.
VNSystem.constructor: new VNSystem(store?: VariableStore) — defaults to a new isolated VariableStore. Pass ctx.variables to share state with the game. The store backs 'condition' nodes and a choice option's `when` field.
VNSystem.DialogueNode: type DialogueNode = { type: 'dialogue'; speaker: string; text: string; voice?: string; next?: string; cgPath?: string } | { type: 'choice'; text: string; options: Array<{ label: string; next: string; when?: VariableCondition }>; cgPath?: string } | { type: 'event'; eventName: string; data?: Record<string, unknown>; next?: string; cgPath?: string } | { type: 'jump'; target: string; cgPath?: string } | { type: 'variable-set'; variableKey: string; variableValue: unknown; next?: string; cgPath?: string } | { type: 'condition'; condition: VariableCondition; ifTrue: string; ifFalse?: string; cgPath?: string }
VNSystem.DialogueTree: interface DialogueTree { nodes: Record<string, DialogueNode>; startNode: string }

load.description: Load a DialogueTree and begin processing from startNode. Not async — convert with storyGraphToDialogueTree() first.

advance.description: Advance past a dialogue, event, or variable-set node to its next. Has no effect on choice nodes.

selectOption.description: Navigate to the target node by ID. Use the next field from the chosen option in a choice node.

currentNode.description: The currently active node, or null if not loaded or finished.

setListener.description: Register the active listener. Replaces any previously set listener. Call before load() so the first onNode is delivered.

removeListener.description: Detach the current listener. Subsequent node events are discarded.

getVariable.description: Retrieve the value of a variable set by a 'variable-set' node, or undefined if not yet set.

notes: Call setListener() before load(). On load(), onNode fires for the first node only if it is a dialogue node.
After the first node, onNode fires for every node the system moves to (including jump, event, variable-set and condition nodes); narrow by node.type.
'jump', 'variable-set' and 'condition' nodes resolve and auto-advance synchronously; 'condition' branches to ifTrue/ifFalse via evaluateCondition(store, condition).
'event' nodes fire onEvent(eventName, data) and wait for advance().
A choice option's `when: VariableCondition` is evaluated before onChoice fires; options that evaluate false are filtered out.
advance() has no effect on choice nodes; use selectOption(next).
No destroy() method and no public current-node-id getter; track progress yourself (selectOption(nodeId) jumps to any node id).
VNSystem.IVNListener: interface IVNListener { onNode?: (node: DialogueNode) => void; onChoice?: (options: ChoiceOption[]) => void; onEvent?: (eventName: string, ...args: unknown[]) => void; onEnd?: () => void; onCGNode?: (cgPath: string) => void }
VNSystem.variables: Map<string, unknown> (readonly) — all variables set by 'variable-set' nodes during playback

VNTextbox.description: Pre-built dialogue box made of widget entities (PanelStyle, Label) spawned through a WidgetTree. Bind to a VNSystem to auto-update. Route pointer input to handlePointerDown(x, y); call update(dt) each frame for the typewriter. Call destroy() on scene unload.
VNTextbox.constructor: new VNTextbox({ canvasWidth, canvasHeight, scene, tree, height?, namePlateHeight?, paddingX?, panelColor?, namePlateColor?, textColor?, fontSize?, fontFamily?, typewriterSpeed? })

bind.description: Wire to a VNSystem; immediately syncs to the current node.

destroy.description: Destroy the textbox's widget entities. Call on scene unload.

handlePointerDown.description: Hit-test the laid-out panel; skips an in-progress reveal or advances the VN. Returns whether the panel was hit.

VNScriptConvert.description: Converts between Story Graph (.storyGraph.json, visual-editor format) and the DialogueTree consumed by VNSystem.load(). Both functions are exported from @emptysock/vn.

CGGallery.description: Tracks CG image unlock state, persisted through a StorageAdapter (not SaveSystem). Unlock flags are stored as a JSON object under a storage key (default 'emptysock_cg_gallery').
CGGallery.constructor: new CGGallery({ entries: CGEntry[] })  // CGEntry = { id: string; imagePath: string; title?: string }

unlock.signature: (adapter: StorageAdapter, id: string, key?: string): Promise<void>
unlock.description: Unlock and persist immediately; no-op if already unlocked.

LightingSystem.import: import { LightingSystem, LightSource, LightOccluder, type AmbientLight, type LightSample, type LightingSystemOptions } from '@emptysock/engine'
LightingSystem.description: Collects LightSource entities (with Transform) each frame, with real occlusion from LightOccluder boxes, and resolves them to world-space LightSample objects. Attach it with renderPipeline.attachLighting(lighting, layerId = 'default') and RenderPipeline.renderFrame() builds the lightmap over the camera's visible rect and multiplies it over that layer every frame; attachLighting(null) detaches and frees the lightmap. Camera rotation is ignored and only the main scene's lights are used.
LightingSystem.constructor: new LightingSystem(options?: { maxLights?: number (default 32); raySamples?: number (default 32) })

collectLights.signature: (scene: Scene, reference?: { x: number; y: number }): LightSample[]
collectLights.description: Enabled lights with radius > 0, resolved to world position, capped at maxLights (nearest to reference win).

properties.ambient: AmbientLight { colour: number (0xRRGGBB), level: number (0..1) }, writable, default { colour: 0xffffff, level: 0 }

LightingSystem.LightSample: { x, y, radius, colour, intensity, falloff, coneAngle (radians), coneDirection (radians), visibility: Point[] | null }
notes: Lights are components: add Transform + LightSource to an entity. Shadows come from LightOccluder (axis-aligned box).
There are no directional/spot/ambient light types, no light ids, no castShadows flag and no normal maps.

NavMeshSystem.import: import { NavMeshSystem, type NavMeshData, type NavPolygon } from '@emptysock/tilemap'
NavMeshSystem.description: A* polygon navmesh for entity pathfinding. Accepts pre-built navmesh data (offline). Does not generate navmesh from tilemaps at runtime.

load.description: Load a pre-built polygon graph. Build this offline in the level editor and ship as a JSON asset.

findPath.description: Find a path between two world-space points. Returns an array of waypoints; returns [] if no path exists. Synchronous.

NavPolygon.vertices: ReadonlyArray<Vec2> — convex polygon vertices in order
NavPolygon.neighbours: ReadonlyArray<number> — ids of adjacent walkable polygons

NavMeshSystem.Vec2: type Vec2 = { x: number; y: number } (exported from @emptysock/engine)
notes: NavMesh data is built offline; there is no runtime generation from tilemap data.
For grid-based pathfinding use AStarSearch from @emptysock/engine over Tilemap.asGrid() (boolean[][], true = walkable).
NavMeshSystem uses polygon-graph A* and is suited to open-world navigation.

TweenManager.import: import { TweenManager, type TweenOptions, type EasingName } from '@emptysock/engine'
TweenManager.description: Interpolates numeric properties on objects over time and provides timers. One per scene; call update(dt) each frame. Each of to/after/every returns a TweenHandle { cancel() }.

to.signature: (target: Record<string, number>, props: Record<string, number>, options: TweenOptions): TweenHandle
to.description: Tween numeric properties of target from their current values to the values in props.

after.description: Run fn once after seconds. Scene-local timer managed by this TweenManager.

every.description: Run fn repeatedly every `seconds` until cancelled or killAll()/destroy().

update.description: Advance all active tweens and timers. Call once per frame in onUpdate(dt).

killAll.description: Cancel every pending tween and timer.

PostProcessSystem.import: import { PostProcessSystem, type PostEffectType, type PostEffectOptions, type LayerFilterOptions } from '@emptysock/engine'
PostProcessSystem.description: Framework-agnostic registry of full-screen effects and per-layer filters; RenderPipeline turns them into real filters. Call update(dt) each frame for transient effects to decay. Effects composite in add order.

add.description: Add or replace a full-screen effect. Returns this for method chaining.

remove.description: Remove a full-screen effect by type.

has.description: Whether the effect is currently active.

get.description: Read the current options for an active effect.

flash.description: Transient full-screen flash. colour is a hex number (default 0xffffff); duration in seconds (default 0.15).

setLayerFilter.description: Apply a filter to a named render layer.

clearLayerFilter.description: Remove the filter from a layer.

toggleLayerFilter.description: Enable or disable a layer's filter without removing it.

update.description: Decay transient effects (flash, shockwave). Call once per frame in onUpdate.

clear.description: Remove all effects and reset scene transitions.

destroy.description: Clear all effects and layer filters. Call in onDestroy.

PostProcessSystem.ColourblindMode: 'protanopia' | 'deuteranopia' | 'tritanopia' — used as LayerFilterOptions.mode when filter type is 'colourblind'

transitionProperties.transitionEffect: TransitionEffect — set by SceneTransitionManager.transition() through attachPostProcess(), read by RenderPipeline.renderTransitionOverlay()

PostProcessSystem.note_scene_transitions: PostProcessSystem structurally satisfies SceneTransitionManager's TransitionEffectSink (beginTransition / transitionProgress / endTransition). Pass it to transitionManager.attachPostProcess() and renderPipeline.attachPostProcess(); renderFrame() then paints the overlay. See skills/21-post-process.md.
notes: The 'colourblind' layer filter applies standard Brettel/Viénot/Machado *simulation* matrices — it shows a non-colourblind player what a colourblind player sees. It is not a correction/daltonisation filter that increases discriminability for a colourblind player.

LayerSystem.import: import { LayerSystem, LAYER, type LayerConfig, type LayerSortKey } from '@emptysock/engine'
LayerSystem.description: Instance-based named render-layer manager. Entities (by numeric entity.eid) are assigned to a layer at an explicit depth; the renderer draws layers in ascending index order, then entities within a layer by ascending depth. Four built-in layers are pre-created. RenderPipeline owns one (render.layers) and syncs it from Sprite.layer / Sprite.depth.

defineLayer.description: Define or redefine a layer. Lower index = drawn behind. Use index gaps (0, 50, 80, 100) so layers can be inserted later without renumbering.

addEntity.signature: (entityId: number, layerName: string, depth?: number): void
addEntity.description: Assign an entity to a layer at an optional depth (default 0). Unknown layerName falls back to 'default' with a warning.

removeEntity.description: Unregister an entity from the layer system. Entity is not destroyed.

setDepth.description: Update an entity's depth within its current layer without changing the layer.

getEntityLayer.description: Returns the entity's current layer name, or null if unregistered.

getEntityDepth.description: Returns the entity's current depth, or 0 if unregistered.

getSortKey.description: Returns [layerIndex, depth] for use in a sort comparator. Unregistered entities get [LAYER.DEFAULT, 0].

getLayerIndex.description: Returns the index of a named layer, or LAYER.DEFAULT if unknown.

setVisible.description: Show or hide an entire layer.

isVisible.description: Returns true if the layer is visible.

getEntitiesOnLayer.signature: (layerName: string): Array<{ entityId: number; depth: number }>
getEntitiesOnLayer.description: All entities on a layer, sorted by depth ascending.

getLayersSorted.description: All layer configs sorted by index ascending (render order). LayerConfig: { name, index, visible }.

setOffset.signature: (name: string, x: number, y: number): void

notes: Use LAYER constants for the four built-in layer indices.
depth within a layer controls fine-grained draw order within the same layer.
Unregistered entities fallback to [LAYER.DEFAULT, 0] in getSortKey.

ActorSystem.import: import { Actor, ActorSystem, type Message, type ActorId } from '@emptysock/engine'
ActorSystem.description: Mailbox-based Actor Model for decoupled game logic. Actors communicate only via messages. Game creates one ActorSystem per scene (ctx.actors) and updates it; construct your own only for standalone use.

Actor.description: Base class for all actors. Extend it and implement receive() and update().

methods.receive: (msg: Message): void — handle an incoming message
methods.update: (dt: number): void — called every frame after all mailboxes are flushed
methods.send: (msg: Message): void — enqueue a message (inbox cap 1000; overflow is dropped with a warning)
methods.start/stop: start(): void / stop(): void — toggle isRunning; call protected onStart()/onStop() hooks

Actor.properties: id: ActorId; isRunning: boolean; inboxSize: number

ActorSystem.description: Manages a set of actors; drains every actor's inbox before calling update() on any actor. Create in onLoad, call update(dt) in onUpdate, call destroy() in onDestroy.

methods.register: (actor: Actor): void — register an actor with the system
methods.send: (id: string, msg: Message): void — enqueue a message to a specific actor
methods.broadcast: (msg: Message): void — enqueue a message to all registered actors (O(n))
methods.update: (dt: number): void — flush all mailboxes then call update(dt) on every actor
methods.destroy: (): void — unregister all actors and free resources. Call in onDestroy.
methods.getAll: (): Actor[] — return a snapshot array of all currently registered actors

notes: Messages sent inside an actor's receive() are processed in the same flush pass — not deferred to the next frame.
An actor that always re-enqueues a message to itself in receive() creates an infinite flush loop.

destroy.description: Free all WASM-allocated physics memory. Required in onDestroy — the GC cannot see WASM memory.

PluginSystem.import: import { PluginSystem, type Plugin, type PluginContext } from '@emptysock/engine'

register.description: Register a plugin and call its install(). A second plugin with an already-registered name logs a warning and is skipped (it does not throw).

unregister.description: Call the plugin's uninstall() method and remove it from the registry.

inject.description: Retrieve a value provided by a plugin via ctx.provide(). Returns undefined if no plugin provided the key.

BattleSystem.import: import { BattleSystem, type BattlePhase, type BattleStats, type BattleStatMap, type DamageContext, type StatusEffect, type Combatant, type SkillTargetType, type DamageFormulaId, type SkillDef, type StatusEffectDef, type BattleDatabase, type BattleAction, type BattleEvent, type BattleSystemOptions } from '@emptysock/battle'
BattleSystem.description: Opt-in turn-based RPG battle module. Handles turn order (speed desc), damage resolution, status effects, and event emission. Tree-shaken from bundles that do not import it. Enemies act automatically (attack lowest-HP party member); party members require submitAction(). Public surface is intentionally narrow: start() begins a battle, submitAction() is the only way to advance it, subscribe() is the only way to observe it.

BattleSystemOptions.db: BattleDatabase — optional, can also be loaded via loadDatabase()
BattleSystemOptions.statMap: BattleStatMap — maps the attack/defense/speed/luck roles to your stat key names (defaults 'attack', 'defense', 'speed', 'luck')

setDamageFormula.description: Replace the formula used for basic attacks and 'physical' skills only. 'magical', 'fixed' and 'percent-max-hp' skills use built-in math.

start.signature: (party: readonly Combatant[], enemies: readonly Combatant[]): void
start.description: Begin a battle with the given roster, replacing any previous one. Replaces the old addPartyMember()/addEnemy() calls. Fires battle-start, then round-start, then action-needed for the first combatant in turn order.

submitAction.description: Submit a party member's action. Only valid when getPhase() === 'input'. Once every party member submits, the round resolves automatically.

subscribe.description: Subscribe to battle events. Returns an unsubscribe function. Replaces the old onEvent() name.

destroy.description: Call on scene unload. Clears all combatants, pending actions, and event listeners.

types.BattleStats: { hp, maxHp, mp, maxMp: number } & Record<string, number> — required fields plus any extra numeric stats
types.BattleStatMap: { attack?: string; defense?: string; speed?: string; luck?: string } — stat key names for each role
types.DamageContext: { attacker: Combatant; target: Combatant; effectiveAttack: number; effectiveDefense: number; power: number; isCrit: boolean; critMultiplier: number } — the single argument to the setDamageFormula callback
types.StatusEffect: { id: string; name: string; turnsRemaining: number } — turnsRemaining -1 = permanent
types.Combatant: { id: string; name: string; stats: BattleStats; statusEffects: readonly StatusEffect[]; isParty: boolean }
types.SkillDef: { id, name, mpCost, targetType: SkillTargetType, formula: DamageFormulaId, power: number, isHeal?: boolean, statusEffect?: { effectId: string; chance: number } }
types.StatusEffectDef: { id, name, hpDrainPercentPerTurn?: number, attackMultiplier?: number, defenseMultiplier?: number }
types.BattleAction: { type: 'attack'; targetId: string } | { type: 'skill'; skillId: string; targetId: string } | { type: 'flee' }
types.BattleEvent: { kind: 'battle-start' } | { kind: 'round-start'; round: number } | { kind: 'action-needed'; combatantId: string } | { kind: 'damage'; sourceId: string; targetId: string; amount: number; isCrit: boolean } | { kind: 'heal'; sourceId: string; targetId: string; amount: number } | { kind: 'mp-cost'; combatantId: string; amount: number } | { kind: 'status-applied'; combatantId: string; effectId: string; name: string } | { kind: 'status-expired'; combatantId: string; effectId: string } | { kind: 'combatant-defeated'; combatantId: string } | { kind: 'victory' } | { kind: 'defeat' } | { kind: 'fled' }

BattleSystem.skillPower: SkillDef.power: 'physical' -> multiplier (basic attack = 1); 'magical' -> multiplier; 'fixed' -> flat amount; 'percent-max-hp' -> fraction of target max HP (0.25 = 25%).
BattleSystem.statusEffects_note: A status effect applied by a skill gets turnsRemaining -1 (permanent). To use durations, put StatusEffect entries with positive turnsRemaining on a Combatant passed to start().

Feeds resize() on a render target (RenderPipeline) and CameraSystem.setViewSize() so they never go stale. Each scene context provides one as ctx.viewport; there is no module singleton.

init.signature: (config: Partial<ViewportConfig>, systems?: { renderTarget?: ResizableRenderTarget, cameraSystem?: CameraSystem }): void
init.description: Wires the render target and CameraSystem to keep in sync, starts resize/orientation listeners, and computes the initial viewport size. Call once during setup.

recompute.description: Recomputes the letterboxed/filled/stretched size and pushes it to the render target and CameraSystem. Called automatically on resize/orientation-change.

setDesignResolution.description: Change the design resolution and recompute.

getSafeAreaInsets.description: Reads CSS env(safe-area-inset-*) via a hidden probe element. Returns all-zero insets outside a browser or on platforms without notch/home-indicator insets.

ViewportConfig.designHeight: number — logical height the game is authored against
ViewportConfig.container: HTMLElement — optional; falls back to window dimensions

ViewportSize.height: number — rendered canvas height in CSS pixels
ViewportSize.scale: number — scale factor from design resolution to rendered size

ViewportSystem.ScaleMode: 'fit' | 'fill' | 'stretch' — fit letterboxes (never crops), fill cover-crops (never letterboxes), stretch fills exactly with no aspect correction

functions.gpuTierRenderDefaults: (tier: 'potato'|'low'|'mid'|'high'|'ultra', devicePixelRatio?: number): { antialias: boolean, resolution: number } — pass the fields into RenderPipeline.init options

DebugOverlaySystem.import: import { DebugOverlaySystem, type DebugLogEntry, type LogLevel } from '@emptysock/engine'
DebugOverlaySystem.description: Shippable in-game FPS/entity-count overlay and dev console, disabled by default. Built from widget entities spawned through a WidgetTree.

update.description: Call once per frame with delta time and current entity count.

logError.description: Intended to be wired to the engine's error hook so runtime errors surface in-overlay.

registerCommand.signature: (name: string, handler: (args: string[]) => string | void): void
registerCommand.description: Register a console command. 'help' and 'clear' are registered by default.

runCommand.description: Parses 'name arg1 arg2' and dispatches to a registered command.

properties.root: Entity — the overlay's root widget entity

CustomShaderFilter.description: A user-authored GLSL post-process filter — the runtime counterpart to the IDE's ShaderEditor panel. A shader written and previewed there compiles through this exact function, so the panel's preview and a game's actual render use one shader-compile path.

uniformContract.vertexUniforms: uProjectionMatrix, uWorldTransformMatrix, uTransformMatrix (mat3) — standard PixiJS v8 filter uniforms
uniformContract.fragmentUniforms: uTexture (sampler2D, the filtered input), uTime (float, seconds — update it yourself via setTime())

CustomShaderFilter.note_glsl: Shaders are GLSL ES 3.00 style (in/out, not attribute/varying; texture(), not texture2D()).

functions.createCustomShaderFilter: createCustomShaderFilter(options: { fragmentSrc: string; vertexSrc?: string; adaptVertex?: boolean; wgslFragment?: string; wgslVertex?: string; name?: string; uniforms?: Record<string, { value: number | number[]; type: string }> }): CustomShaderFilter — a PixiJS Filter with setTime(seconds) and setUniform(name, value)

CustomShaderFilter.usage: Assign the filter to a PixiJS container's `filters` array (for example renderPipeline.stage.filters = [filter]); call filter.setTime(elapsedSeconds) each frame if the shader reads uTime. For shaders shared across many sprites, registerShader(id, { vertexSrc, fragmentSrc }) and set Sprite.shader = id. RenderSystem.addLayerShaderFilter(layerName, filter) also exists on the exported RenderSystem, but RenderPipeline owns its own instance.
CustomShaderFilter.note_vertex: A vertex stage written in the sprite-quad shape (aUV plus the three projection matrices) is adapted automatically to work on a filter; omit vertexSrc to use the default, which is already correct.
CustomShaderFilter.note_wgsl: Without wgslFragment the filter is GL-only and renders nothing under WebGPU.

SequenceSystem.import: import { TweenManager, SequenceSystem, evaluateTrackAt, type SequenceDefinition, type SequenceTrackDef } from '@emptysock/engine'
SequenceSystem.description: Plays a keyframe SequenceDefinition — a list of tracks, each a target property plus keyframes and an optional easing — against a plain numeric target object, by scheduling real TweenManager.to() calls. This is the runtime the IDE's Sequence Editor panel drives; a sequence exported from the panel and a hand-written TweenManager chain produce identical playback, because play() schedules exactly the calls a developer would write by hand.

types.SequenceKeyframe: { time: number, value: number } — shape only; the type is not exported by name
types.SequenceTrackDef: { property: string, keyframes: SequenceKeyframe[], ease?: EasingName }  — property is a key set on the target object, e.g. 'x', 'rotation'; ease defaults to 'linear'

methods.play: seq.play(tweens: TweenManager, target: Record<string, number>, def: SequenceDefinition, startAt?: number): void — sets target[property] to the exact value at startAt immediately, then schedules one to() per remaining keyframe segment with delay measured from startAt, so resuming mid-playback doesn't jump
methods.stop: seq.stop(): void — cancels all scheduled tweens

SequenceSystem.evaluateTrackAt: evaluateTrackAt(track: SequenceTrackDef, time: number): number — a pure, side-effect-free evaluation of a single track at an arbitrary time, using the same per-segment easing math play() schedules; useful for scrubbing/preview without touching a TweenManager instance

core.description: The current entity/component/scene core. Everything here lives directly under @emptysock/engine.

definePrefab.notes: extends flattens other prefabs onto the same entity at spawn time, depth-first; a prefab's own components win on a name collision against anything it extends.
definePrefab.example: const Enemy = definePrefab('Enemy', [{ def: Health, overrides: { max: 50 } }], { extends: [Physical] })

properties.isAlive: boolean — false once destroyed/stale; note: a pooled-and-destroyed entity stays true, see SpawnOptions.pool

SaveSystem.constructor: new SaveSystem(scene: Scene, components: ComponentDef[], options?: SaveSystemOptions)

methods.registerMigration: registerMigration(componentName: string, migrate: (oldData, oldVersion: number) => SerializableRecord): void
methods.peek: peek(slotId: string): Promise<SaveHeader | null> — { formatVersion, meta?, room? } without loading

SaveSystem.SaveSystemOptions: { adapter?, keyPrefix? (default 'emptysock_save_'), relations?, globals?: GlobalStore, variables?: VariableStore, rooms?, carried?, extras?, transferComponents?, room?: () => string | undefined, engineVersion?, gameVersion? }

PhysicsBody.notes: Plain-language wrapper over Rapier. Collision/sensor callbacks (onCollisionEnter, onCollisionExit, onSensorEnter, onSensorExit, onSensorStay) are assigned directly as properties — assigning is registering.

@emptysock/network.notes: Networked fields must be reassigned as a whole new value on change, never mutated in place — NetworkSystem.sync()'s dirty-check uses strict equality against the last-sent value.

SignalBus.import: import { SignalBus, SignalGroup, type GameSignals, type SignalListener, type Unsubscribe } from '@emptysock/engine'
SignalBus.description: Game-wide named signals. One instance per Game (`game.signals`, `ctx.signals` in a scene); never a bare singleton. Dispatch is synchronous, in registration order. A throwing listener never blocks the others; errors are re-thrown together as an AggregateError after all listeners ran. Distinct from ActorSystem (addressed mailboxes).
SignalBus.constructor: Created for you by Game; read it from `game.signals` or `ctx.signals`.

on.signature: <T>(name: string, fn: (payload: T, name: string) => void): Unsubscribe

once.signature: <T>(name: string, fn: (payload: T, name: string) => void): Unsubscribe

onAny.description: Wildcard tap: called for every emitted signal, after that signal's own listeners.

emit.description: Calls every listener of `name`, then the wildcards. Returns how many ran. Nested emits from inside a listener dispatch immediately.

broadcast.description: Emits `payload` to every signal name that currently has at least one listener.

listenerCount.description: Listeners for one name, or all (including wildcards) when omitted.

group.description: A scope whose subscriptions are all removed by one dispose().

methods.onEntity: onEntity<T>(entity: Entity, name: string, fn): Unsubscribe — subscription removed automatically when the entity is destroyed

methods.dispose: (): void — removes everything this group subscribed

SignalBus.GameSignals: Augmentable interface mapping signal names to payload types: `declare module '@emptysock/engine' { interface GameSignals { 'player-died': { id: number } } }`
notes: Subscribe through `bus.group()` in onLoad and dispose() it in onUnload so handlers never outlive their scene.
A listener that re-emits its own signal loops forever; set a flag and emit once from onUpdate instead.

GlobalStore.description: Game-owned map of arbitrary names to arbitrary values, alive for the Game's whole lifetime and shared across scenes (`game.globals`, `ctx.globals`). Not VariableStore: no integer truncation, no numeric index, any value type.
GlobalStore.constructor: Created for you by Game; read it from `game.globals` or `ctx.globals`.

get.signature: get<K extends keyof GameGlobals>(name: K): GameGlobals[K] | undefined; get<T = unknown>(name: string): T | undefined
get.description: undefined until the name is set.

set.signature: set<K extends keyof GameGlobals>(name: K, value: GameGlobals[K]): void; set(name: string, value: unknown): void

clear.description: Clears every global; mainly for test isolation.

methods.declare: declare(name: string, decl?: { initial?: Serializable; persist?: boolean }): void
methods.snapshot: snapshot(): Record<string, Serializable> — persisted globals only
methods.restore: restore(data): void — declared persistent globals only
methods.reset: reset(): void — clear values, re-apply declared initial values

GlobalStore.GameGlobals: Empty augmentable interface: `declare module '@emptysock/engine' { interface GameGlobals { score: number } }` types get/set for declared names; undeclared names use the untyped overloads.
notes: In the IDE the Game Globals panel edits the declarations and saves them in the project file; runtime values are not persisted (use SaveSystem).

RainGlassFilter.import: import { RainGlassFilter, createRainGlassFilter, rainParticlePreset, ParticleEmitter, type RainGlassFilterOptions, type RainPresetOptions } from '@emptysock/engine'
RainGlassFilter.description: Rain on a camera lens/windshield as a single-pass screen-space filter: droplets that refract the scene (inverted miniature, dark rim, glint), static micro drops, big creeping drops, and sliding drops with wet trails. Cost scales with resolution, not drop count. Not a physical simulation (no drops merging).
RainGlassFilter.layerFilter: postProcess.setLayerFilter(layerId, { type: 'rain-glass', intensity?, dropletSize?, dropletSpeed?, streakAmount? }) with the PostProcessSystem attached to the RenderPipeline (`pipeline.attachPostProcess(post)`). Re-calling setLayerFilter updates values in place; time advances automatically.

RainGlassFilterOptions.dropletSize: number — aspect-corrected UV cell size of the big-drop grid; smaller = more, smaller drops. Default 0.12.
RainGlassFilterOptions.dropletSpeed: number — fall speed of sliding drops per second. Default 0.35.
RainGlassFilterOptions.streakAmount: number — 0..1 blend from mostly static drops (0) to mostly sliding drops with trails (1). Default 0.5.

functions.rainParticlePreset: (opts?: { width?: number, density?: number, wind?: number, texture?: string }): ParticleEmitterOptions — world-space rain: a line emitter across the top of the view firing fast, slightly tilted, short-lived, low-alpha drops (max 1200 live). Position the emitter just above the view; mount with `await pipeline.mountParticles(emitter, layer)`.

setResolution.description: Call when the target size changes (the layer-filter path does this for you).

tick.description: Advance time once per frame when you attach the filter yourself.

TextureStore.description: The one shared texture load-and-lookup path used by sprite rendering, draw_sprite, particles, tilemap tilesets and ImageWidget. Most games never touch it.
TextureStore.constructor: new TextureStore(loader?: (path: string) => Promise<Texture>) — with no loader it uses the engine's default asset cache; a custom loader (tests, custom hosts) gets a small local cache plus in-flight de-duplication.

get.description: Already-loaded texture or undefined. Synchronous; never starts a load.

load.description: Loads or resolves from cache. Concurrent calls for one path share one load. A failed load is not cached, so the next call retries.
